description: Conversion of single family dwelling house into 2no. self-contained flats (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no external windows or doors other than those indicated on the approved drawings shall be installed in the development hereby approved without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

The development hereby permitted shall be maintained in accordance with the following approved plans: Location and Block Plan - 00 Existing Side Elevation Plan - 005Existing Rear Elevation Plan - 054 BExisting Ground Floor Plan - 001 BExisting First Floor Plan - 002 CExisting Second Floor Plan - 003 CReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction detailed within the approved drawings / application form. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance

Within 2 months of this permission, details of the internal consumption of potable water shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Submitted details will demonstrate reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to show consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day for the residential uses. The development shall be maintained strictly in accordance with the details so approved.Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Policies CP21 of the Core Strategy (2010) and DMD 58 of the Development Management Document (2014).

Within 2 months of this permission, an updated Energy Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The report shall demonstrate how the development incorporates measures to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon dioxide (CO"²) emissions beyond the baseline requirements of Building Regulations Part L 2021 or any subsequent updates in force at the time of approval. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter. Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that carbon emission reduction targets are met in accordance with the Local Development Plan, the London Plan (2021) and the NPPF (2024).

Within 3 months of this permission, a final Energy Performance Certificate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that carbon emission reduction targets are met in accordance with the Local Development Plan, the London Plan (2021) and the NPPF (2024).

The existing detached outbuilding at the site shall only be used for purposes incidental to the residential occupation of the property, but excluding use for any form of habitable accommodation or business purposes.Reason: To ensure that the development is not used for unlawful purposes and to prevent the introduction of activity which would be detrimental to visual and residential amenities.

Within 2 months of this permission, details of proposed cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate: Location: Near entrances or main access Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered where possible Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Within 2 months of this permission, details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to be provided within the development to accommodate the anticipated number of future occupiers, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024), shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter. Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.
